title: Editor checkers
summary: The checks and editor settings a harness provides to the ✍ suggest editor, one node per content profile, each naming the code (`path.ts#Export`) the editor loads for that profile's blocks.
description: A directory of this kind holds `folio-editor-checker/v1` nodes. Each node names, for a content type and optionally a set of block kinds, the suggestion checker the ✍ suggest editor calls (`checkSuggestion(before, after, ctx)`) and the Crepe settings it applies: the latex feature config, node views, and remark plugins registered first. The editor lives in the shared edit-links runtime (cat-harness-tools `src/core/edit-links.ts`). It finds these nodes through the declaration rather than through a path anyone wrote down.

avatar.reads: a pencil and a tick: an edit, checked as it is made — the qa-checkers' hue, the kind it is modelled on

rationale: Owner, 2026-10-14 (bean folio-assistant-4dx7): declare the paper profile's suggest checkers so the runtime discovers them, and check only syntax, never forbid an edit. The kind is folio-assistant-sci's for the same reason lean.json gives: no central registry for subgraph types (owner, 2026-10-04). It is modelled on `qa-checkers` (bean riit): every contribution is a node, one graph per contribution type. `content`: the nodes are authored. `renderable: false`: there is nothing to render.
